definitions.explanation: An inflammatory skin condition causing redness, itching, and sometimes blisters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{湿疹|しっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a rash on my arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{湿疹|しっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I sometimes get eczema from allergies.

examples.japanese: {湿疹|しっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧、⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My eczema was bad, so I went to a dermatologist.

notes:
WRITING:
{湿|しつ} (wet/damp) + {疹|しん} (rash)

TYPES:
- ⟦アトピー→アトピー：23012_atopii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{湿疹|しっしん} - atopic eczema
- ⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{湿疹|しっしん} - contact dermatitis
- ⟦{脂漏|しろう}→脂漏：30714_shirou⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{湿疹|しっしん} - seborrheic dermatitis

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湿疹|しっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (to develop a rash)
- {湿疹|しっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to break out in a rash)
- {湿疹|しっしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}する→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (to treat eczema)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦かぶれ→かぶれ：25271_kabure⟧ - rash caused by contact with a specific irritant
- ⟦{発疹|はっしん}→発疹：20451_hasshin⟧ - skin eruption; the broader clinical term, of which {湿疹|しっしん} is one kind
- ⟦{蕁麻疹|じんましん}→蕁麻疹：15182_jinmashin⟧ - hives, which come up as raised welts and usually fade within hours

USAGE:
An everyday word, not restricted to medical settings - patients use it themselves when describing symptoms at a clinic or pharmacy. The verb that goes with it is ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ or ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧, not ⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧.
